schema.description: Single source of truth for return policy rules, deadlines, and addresses. SOPs should reference this file instead of hardcoding return information.

deadlines.note: Customer has 14 calendar days from receipt to notify, then 14 days to send items back. Refund issued within 14 days of notification.

eligible: Complete products in original packaging with accessories
Products in a condition that allows nature, characteristics and functioning to be determined
not_eligible: Sealed coatings and cleaners (Pro-Tech+, Prep+) once the seal is broken
Products inseparably mixed with other products after delivery
eligibility.inspection_note: Customer may inspect as in a physical shop. Usage beyond inspection may result in a value reduction charge.

return_address.note: The return address is communicated once the return request is approved and registered. Afterfade BV may direct returns to a specific address or logistics partner.

damaged_orders.action: Contact Afterfade by email, web chat or WhatsApp with order number, description and photos
